info.title: Nodera Core API
info.description: Infrastructure, AI, Agent, and Operations control plane. This spec covers exactly the endpoints implemented today — see docs/ROADMAP.md in the repository for what's planned. Hand-maintained (docs/ROADMAP.md tracks generating it from code instead).

tags.name: ai
tags.description: AI Gateway: profiles, provider/model registry, chat

tags.name: secrets
tags.description: Encrypted-at-rest secret storage (metadata only over HTTP)

tags.name: approvals
tags.description: Human approval workflow for privileged/critical tools

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Agent identity, scoped chat, and scoped tool execution (not an autonomous tool-calling loop — a caller directs which tool an agent uses)

post.summary: Create a user (no org membership yet)

password.description: At least 12 characters, mixing letters with a number or symbol

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a session token
Revoke the current session

get.summary: List organizations the caller belongs to

post.summary: Create an organization; creator becomes owner

put.summary: Rename the current organization and/or change its slug (organization.manage)

409.description: An organization with this slug already exists

post.summary: Register a node (infrastructure.manage)

put.summary: Update a node's editable inventory fields (infrastructure.manage) — identity fields (provider, provider_resource_id) and status are not editable here

post.summary: Register an application (applications.deploy)

put.summary: Update an application's editable fields (applications.deploy) — status is not editable here

node_id.description: Pass the nil UUID to clear it

get.summary: List the caller's own API tokens

post.summary: Create an API token owned by the caller (organization.manage)

put.summary: Rename one of the caller's own tokens — metadata only, scopes are fixed at mint time

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's own tokens

get.summary: List every non-revoked token in the org, any owner (organization.manage)

delete.summary: Revoke any token in the org, regardless of owner (organization.manage)

get.summary: List every role available to the calling organization (system roles + any custom org roles) (organization.manage)

200.description: Roles with their full permission sets

post.summary: Create a custom role scoped to the calling organization (organization.manage) — permissions must be a subset of the caller's own

403.description: A requested permission the caller doesn't hold

409.description: A role with this name already exists in this organization

get.summary: List every member of the calling organization with their currently-assigned roles (organization.manage)

post.summary: Add an existing user (by email) to the calling organization as a member (organization.manage) — does not create an account

201.description: Member added, granted the system 'member' role

404.description: No account exists with this email

409.description: User is already a member of this organization

post.summary: Grant a member an additional role within the calling organization (organization.manage)

204.description: Role assigned (idempotent — already holding it is not an error)

404.description: The user isn't a member of this organization, or the role doesn't exist / isn't available to it

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a member within the calling organization (organization.manage)

404.description: The member did not hold this role

post.summary: Create a service account (organization.manage)

put.summary: Update a service account's name/description (organization.manage) — status is not settable here, see enable/disable

delete.summary: Disable a service account and revoke all its outstanding tokens (organization.manage)

post.summary: Mint a token owned by the service account (organization.manage)
Enqueue a job (jobs.manage)
Cancel a queued job
Create an AI profile (ai.manage)
Call the AI gateway with a profile key + messages (ai.use)

503.description: No available, policy-compliant model for this profile

post.summary: Register/update a provider (ai.manage, platform-wide)
Register/update a model under an existing provider (ai.manage)

get.summary: List secret metadata only — never values (secrets.read)

post.summary: Execute a tool — read/safe run immediately, privileged/critical return an approval instead

501.description: Tool has no execution backend yet (NOT_IMPLEMENTED)

get.summary: List the calling organization's per-tool approval TTL overrides (tools.manage)

200.description: Overrides for this organization; a tool with no row here uses the 24h default

put.summary: Set (or update) this organization's approval TTL override for a tool (tools.manage)

400.description: approval_ttl_seconds out of range, or an unknown tool key

delete.summary: Clear this organization's approval TTL override for a tool, reverting to the 24h default (tools.manage)

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending approval (approvals.decide)

409.description: Approval is no longer pending (already decided or expired)

post.summary: Create an agent, starting disabled (agents.manage)

put.summary: Update an agent's configuration (agents.manage) — permission_scope must remain a subset of the caller's own

403.description: A requested permission the caller doesn't hold

delete.summary: Permanently delete an agent (agents.manage) — must be disabled first

409.description: Agent must be disabled before it can be deleted

post.summary: Enable an agent so it can Run or execute tools (agents.manage)
Disable an agent (agents.manage)
Chat with the agent via its configured AI profile and system_instructions (agents.execute)
Execute a tool on the agent's behalf, under its own scoped identity (agents.execute) — the caller chooses the tool, not the agent

403.description: Tool not in the agent's allowed_tool_keys, or outside its permission_scope

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only rows created at or after this time are returned. Unparsable/missing values are ignored, not rejected.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp; only rows created at or before this time are returned. Unparsable/missing values are ignored, not rejected.

put.summary: Replace a custom role's entire permission set (organization.manage) — refuses system roles

404.description: Not a custom role of this organization (includes every system role)

delete.summary: Delete a custom role (organization.manage) — refuses if any member still holds it

404.description: Not a custom role of this organization

409.description: Role is still assigned to one or more members

put.summary: Rename a custom role and/or change its description (organization.manage) — permission set is untouched; refuses system roles

404.description: Not a custom role of this organization (includes every system role)

409.description: A role with this name already exists in this organization

put.summary: Update the calling user's own display name

post.summary: Change the calling user's own password — revokes every other active session, leaving the current one untouched

get.summary: List the calling user's own active sessions, most recent first

200.description: Active sessions, with is_current marking the one making this request

delete.summary: Revoke one of the calling user's own sessions ("log out that device")

404.description: Not one of the caller's own active sessions

post.summary: Report a node's current status (infrastructure.manage) — what a future Node Agent heartbeat would call; also stamps last_seen_at
Permanently retire a node (infrastructure.manage) — terminal and one-way; the row is kept, not deleted, and idempotent to call again
Report an application's current status (applications.deploy)
Permanently retire an application (applications.deploy) — terminal and one-way; the row is kept, not deleted, and idempotent to call again
Re-queue a failed job for another full attempt cycle (jobs.manage) — attempts/progress/error reset, same job ID

409.description: Job is not in a retryable (failed) state, or does not exist

put.summary: Update an AI profile's configuration (ai.manage) — key is immutable; only org-owned profiles can be updated

403.description: A requested permission the caller doesn't hold

404.description: No org-owned profile with this id (system-defined profiles cannot be updated this way)

delete.summary: Permanently delete an org-owned AI profile (ai.manage)

404.description: No org-owned profile with this id (system-defined profiles cannot be deleted this way)

post.summary: Re-enable a disabled service account (organization.manage) — does not restore tokens revoked at disable-time

patch.summary: Update a secret's description without touching its value (secrets.manage)

delete.summary: Remove a member from the calling organization (organization.manage) — cascades to their role grants

404.description: Not a member of this organization

409.description: Refused — this would remove the organization's last owner

post.summary: Leave the current organization — remove the caller's own membership

409.description: Refused — the caller is the organization's last owner

delete.summary: Permanently delete an AI provider registry row (ai.manage) — cascades to every model registered under it

404.description: No provider registered with this key

delete.summary: Permanently delete a single AI model registry row (ai.manage)

404.description: No such model registered under this provider

get.summary: List the calling organization's own AI usage history, most recent first (ai.use) — no prompt/response content, operational metrics only

delete.summary: Permanently delete a service account (organization.manage) — must already be disabled; cascades to every token it ever held

409.description: Service account must be disabled before it can be deleted

post.summary: Withdraw the caller's own pending approval request — no approvals.decide required, only the original requester can cancel

403.description: Caller did not request this approval

409.description: Approval is no longer pending (already decided, cancelled, or expired)

post.summary: Revoke every one of the calling user's sessions except the current one ("log out all other devices")

get.summary: List the full platform permission catalog (any authenticated user)
List the calling user's own platform permission grants
List every platform permission grant in the system (platform.admins.manage)

post.summary: Grant a platform permission to a user (platform.admins.manage)

get.summary: List platform secret metadata, never values (platform.secrets.read)

put.summary: Create or rotate a platform secret (platform.secrets.manage)

patch.summary: Update a platform secret's description without resupplying its value (platform.secrets.manage)

bearerAuth.description: A session token (POST /auth/login) or an API token (POST /api-tokens / POST /service-accounts/{id}/api-tokens). See docs/API.md Authenticating.

OrgHeader.name: X-Nodera-Org
OrgHeader.description: Required for a session token (which org to act within). Optional for an API token, which already embeds one — if present it must match.

scopes.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

token.description: The raw token — shown exactly once, never retrievable again

permission_scope.description: Permission keys this agent acts with — never broader than its creator's own permissions at creation time

allowed_tool_keys.description: Each key must already exist in the tool registry

permission_scope.description: Must be a subset of the caller's own permissions

Page.description: The standard pagination envelope every paginated list endpoint returns (internal/platform/httpserver.Page). Concrete endpoints narrow `items`'s element type via allOf — see NodePage, ApplicationPage, JobPage, AuditRecordPage.
